source: Price: Idaho State Tax Commission avg prices received, 2018-2022 (min/avg/max of 5 years). Yield: USDA NASS Idaho 2023 state avg (204 bu/ac); low/high are +-~13% since no historical percentile data was accessible in the time available. Cost: representative South-Central Idaho irrigated field corn budget magnitude (approximate -- UI Extension AgBiz budget files were not machine- accessible). Water: Kimberly AgriMet 30-yr seasonal ET.

Price: Idaho State Tax Commission avg prices received, 2018-2022. Yield: USDA NASS Idaho 2023 state avg (4.4 ton/ac); low/high approximate. Cost: representative established alfalfa-hay production budget magnitude (approximate). Water: Kimberly AgriMet 30-yr ET.

Price: Idaho spring-wheat avg prices 2018-2022 used as a close proxy (2022 winter wheat was $7.97 vs spring $8.20, tracking closely). Yield: approximate Idaho state average. Cost: representative South-Central Idaho winter wheat budget magnitude (approximate). Water: Kimberly AgriMet winter-grain seasonal ET.

Price: Idaho State Tax Commission avg prices received, 2018-2022. Yield: approximate, slightly below winter wheat (shorter season). Cost: representative budget magnitude (approximate). Water: approx., slightly below winter grain (Kimberly AgriMet).

Price: Idaho feed-barley avg prices received, 2018-2022. Yield: approximate Magic Valley irrigated average. Cost: representative feed-barley budget magnitude (approximate). Water: approximate, similar to spring grain (Kimberly AgriMet).

Price: Idaho State Tax Commission avg prices received, 2018-2022. Yield: USDA NASS Idaho 2023 state avg (440 cwt/ac). Cost: representative Russet Burbank storage/fumigation budget magnitude (approximate -- potatoes are by far the most input-intensive crop here). Water: Kimberly AgriMet 30-yr ET.

Price: Idaho State Tax Commission avg prices received, 2018-2021 (2022 not reported). Yield: USDA NASS Idaho 2023 forecast (39.4 ton/ac). Cost: representative Roundup Ready sugarbeet budget magnitude (approximate). Water: approximate, long-season high-water crop, above corn and below alfalfa.

Price: Idaho dry-bean avg prices received, 2018-2022. Yield: USDA NASS Idaho 2023 state avg (24.7 cwt/ac). Cost: representative dry bean budget magnitude (approximate). Water: approximate, shortest- season crop in this set.
